objective.metric: worst-case stopband gain, 19 kHz-1 MHz, over all 1024 vertices of the contract tolerance box, real op-amp model (shim)

hard_constraints.quantity: worst-case passband flatness over all corners (dB)
hard_constraints.reserve_why: frequency-grid discretisation of the 50 Hz-1 kHz sweep (a peak could fall between grid points); about 4 orders above jitter

hard_constraints.quantity: gain at 400 Hz, MIN over all corners (V/V), read from the pipeline's corners_summary.json gain_min
gain at 400 Hz, MAX over all corners (V/V), read from corners_summary.json gain_max
nominal stopband gain 19 kHz-1 MHz (dB); must not be worse than baseline + jitter

hard_constraints.rule: every check that is passed in the baseline is passed in the candidate (no new failed/blocked/not_tested/error)

allowed_edits.note: A value edit without a matching MPN edit fails BOM_CONSISTENCY (blocked -> failed) and is rejected as a regression. An MPN edit forces mpn_status -> unverified_candidate: the new orderable part is NOT manufacturer-sheet verified (see claims_never_made).

non_regression.margin_source: record `margin`, else parsed from record `limit` ("<= a" / ">= a"); metrics with no margin and no parsable limit must keep their status

REQ-STAB.rule: value must not exceed baseline + jitter (no degradation); a failed->passed change is needs_review (rejected as a claim; the contract owner, not this task, decides REQ-STAB)

REQ-BOM.rule: stays failed; release/bom.csv rows may differ from baseline ONLY in the edited refs, and ONLY by MPN / MPN_Status becoming unverified_candidate

BOM_CONSISTENCY.rule: stays blocked with 0 MISMATCH lines; failed is a regression

claims_never_made: BOM_VERIFICATION of any edited part: new MPNs are unverified_candidate (decoded-consistent only; existence/orderability and datasheet not checked)
MODEL_STARTUP / MODEL_SATURATION / MODEL_OVERLOAD_RECOVERY behaviour of the modified stage-2 time constant (checks stay not_tested)
hardware validation, temperature, supply/ripple behaviour (no source/ripple requirement exists in the contract)

bom_consistency.detail: 15 lines: 14 consistent, 0 MISMATCH, 1 unresolved | unresolved: J1,J2 | C6,C7: rating margin note: 5.25 V applied = 52% of the 10 V rating; effective-capacitance coverage under bias MISSING (no manufacturer curve)

ac_response.conditions: nominal parts, Rs = 100 ohm, real TI model (shim), ngspice 44.2

note: baseline measured by the trusted pipeline; the evaluator re-runs the FULL pipeline (all corners) on your design; fast checks are nominal only
